content.thinking: Interesting: local master is 1f81129, origin/master updated to fc562bf. rev-list says 2 left (master ahead 2) and 22 right (PR ahead 22)?? And merge-tree says unrelated histories — meaning the local shallow clone has grafted history. Let me check: this is probably a shallow clone with depth. `git rev-list --left-right --count` gave 2 and 22 which suggests merge base exists but histories unrelated... Actually "refusing to merge unrelated histories" — maybe fetch produced shallow boundary. Let's check `git log --oneline -5 origin/master` and `git merge-base`.

arguments.command: cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; cat .git/shallow 2>/dev/null | head; echo '--- master log ---'; git log --oneline -5 origin/master; echo '--- pr log ---'; git log --oneline -5 origin/automation/pi/tungshing-160; echo '--- merge-base ---'; git merge-base origin/master origin/automation/pi/tungshing-160 || echo "no merge base"
